/**
 * Shared LIVE-PREVIEW OAuth client (server-only — NEVER import from the client).
 *
 * The sandbox serves each live preview on a dynamic `https://*.grok-sandbox.com`
 * URL, which can't be pre-registered per app. The broker instead exposes ONE
 * shared "preview" client that accepts any
 * `https://*.grok-sandbox.com/api/auth/oauth2/callback/*`
 * (broker: `app-builder-deployer/auth/src/preview-oauth.ts`). Baking it here lets
 * the live preview do REAL sign-in — no demo/mock users — with no platform
 * injection. When deployed the deployer injects a per-app
 * `GROK_AUTH_*` that overrides these (see `server.ts`).
 *
 * These MUST equal the broker's `GROK_PREVIEW_CLIENT_ID` /
 * `GROK_PREVIEW_CLIENT_SECRET` (set in the broker's Vercel env; the broker stores
 * only the secret's `base64url(SHA-256)` hash). This is a dedicated, low-privilege
 * client (preview-only, `*.grok-sandbox.com`) — rotate it by regenerating the
 * broker env var and this constant together.
 */
export const PREVIEW_CLIENT_ID = "grok_preview";
export const PREVIEW_CLIENT_SECRET =
  "***REMOVED***";

/** The shared auth broker issuer (OIDC discovery lives under it). */
export const GROK_ISSUER_DEFAULT = "https://auth.grok.me";

/**
 * Host patterns whose callbacks the preview client accepts. Better Auth derives
 * the live preview's real origin from the request host and validates it against
 * this list (wildcard-matched), so the OAuth `redirect_uri` becomes the concrete
 * `https://<preview-host>/api/auth/oauth2/callback/...` the broker allows.
 */
export const PREVIEW_ALLOWED_HOSTS = ["*.grok-sandbox.com"] as const;

  if (!pending) return "PENDING CALENDAR ACTION: none. Do not open Calendar unless Dylan explicitly says open/show/pull up/go to Calendar.";

  const when = detail?.when ? ` Stored when: ${detail.when}.` : " Date/time is already stored.";
  const title = detail?.title ? ` Working title: ${detail.title}.` : " Title is unresolved.";
  const need = detail?.need || "name";
  return `PENDING CALENDAR ACTION: CREATE_EVENT is waiting (need=${need}).${when}${title} Do NOT call navigate_calendar. Do NOT create another event. If Dylan names the call, call create_owner_calendar_event with that title and the stored when. If he says can you hear me, answer yes and keep this pending. If he says that is not the name, ask what to name it.`;
}

function pendingProspectEditInstruction(pending: AraDeskContext["pendingProspectEdit"]): string {
  if (!pending) return "PENDING PROSPECT EDIT: none.";
  const detail = typeof pending === "object" ? pending : null;
  const need = detail?.need || "fields";
  const uid = detail?.uid ? ` prospect_uid=${detail.uid}.` : " Use the currently open prospect_uid.";
  if (need === "fields") {
    return `PENDING PROSPECT EDIT: waiting for field values.${uid} Dylan already said add/update information. The next values apply to THAT prospect. Do not ask for the company name again. Do not guess fields. Call update_prospect_information with the values. If he still has not given values, ask “What would you like to add or update?”`;
  }
  if (need === "confirm_destructive") {
    return `PENDING PROSPECT EDIT: waiting for confirmation to clear contact information.${uid} Do not clear until he says yes.`;
  }
  return `PENDING PROSPECT EDIT: waiting for whether a phone is the business phone or the decision maker’s phone.${uid}`;
}

    if (open.owner_notes) lines.push(`Owner notes (OWNER PROVIDED, not public research): ${open.owner_notes}`);
    if (open.explain) lines.push(`Verified take: ${open.explain.slice(0, 400)}`);
    lines.push("If Dylan asks who owns it and decision maker is UNKNOWN, say Decision maker unknown. Do not invent a person's name.");
    lines.push("Owner-provided contact info may be used to draft ‘Hi John…’ but do not claim it was independently verified unless evidence says so.");
  }
  if (ctx.tasks.length) {
    lines.push(`Owner tasks: ${ctx.tasks.map((t) => t.title).join("; ")}.`);
  }
  return lines.join("\n");
}

          code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/worker-body -w "%{http_code}" \

            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${JOB_SECRET}" \
            -H "x-job-secret: ${JOB_SECRET}" \

          if [ -f src/components/owner-desk.tsx ] && grep -q FindVerticalField src/components/owner-desk.tsx && [ "$(wc -c < src/components/owner-desk.tsx)" -gt 100000 ]; then
            echo "Already restored; nothing to do"

          fi
          git show 4e3de1ef2504854169513d7aa0d1284bc724bc88:src/components/owner-desk.tsx > src/components/owner-desk.tsx
          python3 <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re
          p = Path("src/components/owner-desk.tsx")
          src = p.read_text()
          old_imp = 'import { VoiceBar } from "@/components/voice-bar";\n'
          new_imp = old_imp + 'import { FindVerticalField } from "@/components/find-vertical-field";\n'
          if "find-vertical-field" not in src:
              if old_imp not in src:
                  raise SystemExit("VoiceBar import not found")
              src = src.replace(old_imp, new_imp, 1)
          pat = re.compile(
              r'            <label className="la-label">What kind of company\?</label>\n'
              r'            <input\n'
              r'              className="la-field mb-3"\n'
              r'              list="la-verticals"\n'

              r'            </datalist>\n',
          )
          src2, n = pat.subn('            <FindVerticalField value={vert} onChange={setVert} />\n', src, count=1)
          if n != 1:
              raise SystemExit(f"datalist block replace failed n={n}")
          if "la-verticals" in src2:
              raise SystemExit("la-verticals still present")
          p.write_text(src2)
          print("ok", len(src2.encode()))
          PY

name: Lascengine Sentinel Deep

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "15 12 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  deep:
    name: Daily deeper verification
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: POST Sentinel deep check
        env:
          JOB_SECRET: ${{ secrets.OUTREACH_JOB_SECRET }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${JOB_SECRET}" ]; then
            echo "OUTREACH_JOB_SECRET repository secret is not set"
            exit 1
          fi
          code=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/sentinel-body -w "%{http_code}" \
            -X POST "https://lamb-ascension-engine.vercel.app/api/jobs/sentinel?mode=deep" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer ${JOB_SECRET}" \
            -H "x-job-secret: ${JOB_SECRET}" \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            --data '{"mode":"deep"}' \
            --max-time 90)
          echo "HTTP ${code}"
          cat /tmp/sentinel-body || true
          if [ "${code}" -lt 200 ] || [ "${code}" -ge 300 ]; then
            echo "sentinel deep returned non-2xx"
            exit 1
          fi
